question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
What was your favorite part about the college visit?
How do you feel about $ZOE's sacrifice at the end?
options: I liked it, but I'm sad.

labels: That's what I love about him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll be in the car...
Howard trudges off toward the car...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where's Howard going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We, um, just remembered that we have a dentist appointment!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You guys go to the dentist together?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's extreme tooth care!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I hate the dentist! She's always telling me to stop eating so much candy! My body, my rights!
As $ZOE heads over to her car, she sees Howard sitting slumped in the passenger seat. A deep worry fills her...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've never seen Howard like this before... There must be something I can do!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... I know what'll cheer him up!
$ZOE pulls out her phone...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hello? $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Bryce! I need a favor...
Early the next morning, $ZOE knocks lightly on the door to Howard's house... Eventually, it opens...
Howard is standing there in his pajamas, his hair sticking out every which way!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you doing here, $ZOE? It's... Like... Four in the morning or something.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not `that` early! Besides, I have a surprise for you! Get dressed!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] early! Besides, I have a surprise for you! Get dressed!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mrmph.
A few minutes later, $ZOE is once again driving Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is this another attempt to cheer me up? Because the last one didn't take.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I told you that I don't want to be around people.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think you do... You just haven't been spending time with `the right` people!
nodes.text_bbcode: I think you do... You just haven't been spending time with [color=#3b78e2][i]the right[/i][/color] people!

nodes.text: After a lengthy drive, $ZOE and Howard arrive at Centerscore U!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What have you got planned?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nothing much... Ready to get your college on?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's times like these when I realize I don't deserve someone as nice as you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, stop it. Come on!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The representative from Kingston University is coming here soon.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? Why?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Angie wants to get into this special program, and she has to impress him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She can't impress him somewhere else?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's already set. She made a mistake. She knows it.
All of the delight that had been on Howard's face is gone...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for telling me. That couldn't have been easy.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure.
$ZOE looks deep into Howard's eyes... And she just can't muster the will to tell him...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Before I tell you, remember how much fun we had over Fourth of July!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wasn't that a blast! No pun intended, but...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And we even got to repel Wilson High's attack. I remember you were so...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just give me the bad news now, okay? There's no point in delaying it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine...
$ZOE tells Howard about the Kingston representative. The joy that had been on Howard's face leaves him.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I see why you hesitated...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just tell me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, I think it'd be best if I told him.
$ZOE walks over to Howard...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So then I just ran as fast as I could!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It was amazing! He might have broken the land speed record!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I wish you guys had taken a picture of Alexei covered in lizards!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I believe the sound he made was `Yaaaaaaaaaaab!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I believe the sound he made was [color=#e23b3b][i]Yaaaaaaaaaaab![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hahaha!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um, Howard? Can I talk to you for a second?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure...
$ZOE pulls Howard aside...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, you know what, $ZOE? This has been kinda fun. You were totally right.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I feel a lot more cheerful.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hold that feeling... There's something I have to tell you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Then why do I feel so bad?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because it only `feels` like you did something wrong.
nodes.text_bbcode: Because it only [color=#3b78e2][i]feels[/i][/color] like you did something wrong.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's like you said, you're busy tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And even though seeing the rep is going to devastate Howard, you didn't have a choice.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not like you could have scheduled the meeting for later today or tried harder to fit him into your schedule tomorrow or anything...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh... Actually... I probably could have...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Kites are like birds without wings!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I guess I'll tell Howard about my mistake...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You could have scheduled his arrival for after the gathering...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You could have rescheduled whatever you have going on tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I didn't think of that...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You could have asked me first!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm... I'm really sorry, $ZOE. Can you forgive me? Please?
$ZOE looks across to Howard, who is blissfully recounting the events of Operation Lizard Blizzard. She sighs.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I forgive you. I'm just upset because it looks like Howard's finally enjoying himself...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And this is going to be tough for him to hear.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I guess I'll tell him...
A few minutes later, $ZOE and Howard arrive at the park.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, everyone! We're here!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! I love seeing you guys! You're always so...
Amanda sees Howard's face...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Never mind! Has anyone looked at the sky?! It's `sooooooo` blue!
nodes.text_bbcode: Never mind! Has anyone looked at the sky?! It's [color=#3b78e2][i]sooooooo[/i][/color] blue!

nodes.text: Hector comes over and pats Howard on the back!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: My bro! Ben and I were just telling $Scott the deets of our epic prank on Wilson's graduation!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, tell him about `Operation Baby Lizards Everywhere!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, tell him about [color=#e23b3b][i]Operation Baby Lizards Everywhere![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Dude! I told you... I'm in charge of naming stuff. We're calling it `Operation Lizard Blizzard!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Dude! I told you... I'm in charge of naming stuff. We're calling it [color=#e23b3b][i]Operation Lizard Blizzard![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That `is` better...
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] better...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That day was pretty fun...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Now that you're going to be heading off to college, I bet more and more of your days are going to be like that one...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, man! Football, pranks, parties! I can't wait for the day I get to go to Centerscore U!
Nearby, $ZOE and Amanda are talking, while Angie is off by herself on a phone call...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, the sky is pretty blue, Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I know! Have you looked at lakes? Those are blue too!
Angie returns...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sorry... I had to take that call...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If you don't mind my asking, who was it?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It was the representative from Kingston University...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Congratulations, by the way! I heard you got in!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I really want to get into their business school program... But in order to do that, I have to impress their rep.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'm sure you did! You're an impressive student, Angie!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's not just about being impressive. Incoming Kingston students have to demonstrate particular qualities `face-to-face,` depending on their field of concentration.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not just about being impressive. Incoming Kingston students have to demonstrate particular qualities [color=#3b78e2][i]face-to-face,[/i][/color] depending on their field of concentration.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: My field of concentration is blue!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Anyway... The representative is only in Centerscore for today and tomorrow, and I'm really busy tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So...
Angie leans in and whispers...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: So I told him to come by the park!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Why is that a problem? Oh no! Is he afraid of kites?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's no way Howard can handle seeing the Kingston rep now! Not after what happened!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm really sorry... I just didn't have another choice!
$ZOE sings along...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { I'm so lucky... {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { To be with you... {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { And I'll be lucky... {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { As long as we are two... {
Howard reaches over and turns the radio off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE. I love it when you sing. I'm just...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not in the mood... It's too sad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's okay...
They ride on in silence...
As Howard presses his head against the window, $ZOE casually presses the button that rolls the window down!
`Bzzzzrp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Bzzzzrp![/b]

nodes.text: Howard's head slides down!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee!
$ZOE rolls the window back up...
`Bzzzzrp!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Bzzzzrp![/b]

nodes.text: And Howard's head rises up with it!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you having fun over there?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Quite a bit actually.
Howard sits up in his seat.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, I'll try to enjoy this 'gathering'.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I owe you one for the window trick.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't wait...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well...
$ZOE buries her head in her hands!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I admit it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As sad as I feel knowing Howard won't attend the school he wants...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Another part of me is really really `really` happy about it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Another part of me is really really [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] happy about it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's only natural...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is it? Is it, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When you love someone, you're supposed to want the best for them!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And here I am, selfishly wanting the best for me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It may not feel nice, but don't you at least feel relief for getting that out in the open?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I feel awful and horrible all at the same time!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're not a horrible person, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I am an awful one!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not what I said!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You didn't have to say it, Sam. I already feel it...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But nice try, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I had to give it a shot... You know, you're less of a pushover than you used to be!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Publicly exposing Jessica's evil will do that to a girl...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I might have avoided confessing my awful feelings to Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But they're still my feelings...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `do` feel happy that Howard's going to Centerscore U. instead of Kingston!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] feel happy that Howard's going to Centerscore U. instead of Kingston!

nodes.text: Sam sits down on the bed next to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... Howard's really sad about all this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... He's pretty down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That surprises me... I always thought of him as a Centerscore U. kind of guy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I did too. I think maybe everyone did...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I'm sure you've already got some super sweet plan to cheer him up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know me so well! I planned a picnic with some friends...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hope it works...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too...
The next day, $ZOE is driving Howard to the park...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is this event we're going to again?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a little gathering I put together for you and some of your friends...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought you could use some cheering up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't really want to be cheered up right now, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you don't. No one ever `wants` to be cheered up, but they're always cheerful once they are!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you don't. No one ever [color=#3b78e2][i]wants[/i][/color] to be cheered up, but they're always cheerful once they are!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I can't argue with that logic...
Howard presses his head against the car window... A slow pop song comes on the radio...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's all Jessica's fault, you know. She totally ruined his chances with the Kingston interviewer by getting Ryan to pick a fight with him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? You're going to just avoid the subject altogether?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not the $ZOE I know. The $ZOE I know is compelled to tell the truth...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I am telling the truth...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, okay... Technically, you haven't lied. But we both know you're feeling at least a little bit happy that Howard's going to be closer to home...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't you have this insatiable urge to get that out? To tell me how you're really feeling?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kingston was Howard's top choice...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not talking about Howard, $ZOE! You can't tell me you don't feel even a smidge of guilty happiness?

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: Joy fills $ZOE...
Howard clears his throat...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The reason we play sports is to bring people together for an incredible competition...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A live event that thrills us, all of us, in one moment.
The professor claps his hands together!

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Bravo! What's your name, son?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Howard.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Howard! My new favorite pupil! See me after class!
After class, $ZOE and Howard approach the professor.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: My new favorite pupil, Howard, and his... Girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yup! I'm $ZOE. We loved your class!

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Delightful! Howard, why haven't I seen you in my class before?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not actually in your class, sir. I'm going to be attending Centerscore U. in the fall.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Great gravy! You're as new as they get! Are you planning on getting into sports medicine?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I am.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: What have you studied so far?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard just graduated from high school. He hasn't...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've done some research on contributing factors to musculoskeletal injuries and I've read articles related to concussion prevention in football...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Particularly in younger athletes.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Impressive.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, what are some other classes I might end up taking if I wanted to become a sports medicine major?
The professor shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: None.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: There is no sports medicine major here at Centerscore U. If you really wanted to get into that field, you'd have to go to another college...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Like Kingston University?

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: They have an excellent program there, yes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay... Um... Thanks... Come on, $ZOE... Let's go home.
On the road home, $ZOE and Howard sit in silence for a long while.
Finally, as the car turns the corner onto his street, Howard takes a deep breath and speaks...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thank you so much for doing this for me, $ZOE. It meant the world to me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You had a good time?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? This was one of the greatest days of my life!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My girlfriend showed me how much fun I'm going to have at the college I'm going to. What other guy is this lucky?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what about you feeling like college will just be a repeat of high school? Or the pressure to play football? Or the lack of a sports medicine major?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look, all those things aren't really that big of a deal. If college is anything like the time I've spent with you in high school... Then that's fine by me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And like I said, football `is` fun.
nodes.text_bbcode: And like I said, football [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] fun.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But what about your major?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The more I think about it, the more I see sports medicine and Kingston as like this really desperate attempt to be something I'm not.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But Centerscore U. `is` me.
nodes.text_bbcode: But Centerscore U. [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm going to go to great parties, I'm going to play football, I'm going to take fun classes... It's my future!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But is it what you want?
$ZOE stops the car in front of Howard's house. Howard turns to her and touches her face gently...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You mean, do I want to have someone like you living a stone's throw away? Someone so perfect, someone who would plan a day like today for me?
He kisses her with all the love he's ever felt for her. At long last... They part.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course it's what I want.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is what you're interested in... Why not get the full experience, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You're the best... You're always supporting me!
Howard raises his hand...

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Yes! A thought on the matter?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This isn't high school. You don't want to disrupt things.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I'm not really in high school anymore, am I?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess that's true...
The professor catches them talking and singles Howard out!

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Young man, is there something you'd like to add to this discussion?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Should what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Something?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're not even making sense!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When we were out there playing, it felt just like when we were back in high school.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I always thought when I went to college, things would be different, you know?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it's like I'm already on this... Path. I mean, look at $USR and Bryce.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is the way things are here. I'll be $USR's sidekick again. We'll play football. I'll probably join M.A.N., and everything will go how it always goes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It doesn't have to be that way. If you don't want to play football, you don't have to!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How would I explain that to the guys? Besides, it's not like I hate football.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I'm just feeling a little lost.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, I've got an idea. Why don't we go check out one of the classes here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Those will be `very` different from high school classes.
nodes.text_bbcode: Those will be [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] different from high school classes.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, that sounds good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know just the class too!
A few minutes later, $ZOE and Howard step into a large, auditorium-sized classroom.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa... `This` is a class? You could fit three hundred people in here!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa... [color=#e23b3b][i]This[/i][/color] is a class? You could fit three hundred people in here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See? Not like high school at all, is it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Understatement of the year...
As students begin trickling in, $ZOE sees an old man wearing a tie come in through a side door near the front of the room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That must be the professor.
$ZOE and Howard find seats. The professor places a tattered briefcase on the table in the front.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: He looks so old-fashioned and boring... Why'd you pick `this` class?
nodes.text_bbcode: He looks so old-fashioned and boring... Why'd you pick [color=#e23b3b][i]this[/i][/color] class?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You'll see...

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Welcome! Welcome! Welcome! Today's subject is Medicine in Sports: The Itch to Cure Jocks!

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: If you're here for jock itch, well, I'm not that kind of doctor.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Haha`ha!` Never mind... This guy's great!
nodes.text_bbcode: Haha[color=#e23b3b][i]ha![/i][/color] Never mind... This guy's great!

nodes.text: Howard playfully nudges $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And it's a class on sports medicine... The field I want to study!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I might have chosen it for just that reason...

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: To start today's lesson, I wanted to ask all of you, some who are presumably intending to become sports physicians...

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: And some who took this class because it's been correctly labeled as an `easy A.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And some who took this class because it's been correctly labeled as an [color=#e23b3b][i]easy A.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The students chuckle.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Why? Why is this field important? Why do we care about our athletes?

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Most importantly, why do sports matter?
The professor looks around... A familiar guy near the front raises his hand.

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Sports allow us to express our deepest emotions... Like anger... Or sadness.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: True...  Sports certainly have an emotional component... But you can get feelings from other, less competitive activities...
$ZOE sees Howard stir in his seat... A dark-haired girl in the back raises her hand.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Athletes are symbols of beauty. The human form at its peak.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Indeed! But if my gym is any indicator, we can reach peak human form without sports.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: And no one is really buying tickets to watch people workout, are they?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Hey, if my gym sold tickets, I'd watch!
The class laughs.

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: Inappropriate!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Professor
nodes.text: No, I kid. I kid. But, Funny Guy, why don't you tell me why you think sports matter? Go!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Uh, well, uh...
Howard leans over toward $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I think I know the answer.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, you should...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No. I mean, it's always nice to see those guys.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then what is it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess that's it. You know me so well...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How could I not know my Howard?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now why don't you tell me about it?
Howard grabs a muffin and takes a big bite.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Delicious!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Let me try one of those!
Bryce and $USR grab muffins.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Wow!

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Nice!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: $ZOE, thanks for all your help.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank `you` for letting us crash your party.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thank [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] for letting us crash your party.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Are you kidding? You and Howard are welcome here any time!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Well, I'm glad Bryce feels so comfortable inviting people into `my` sorority!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I'm glad Bryce feels so comfortable inviting people into [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] sorority!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Heh. Well, our frat will always welcome you two in if you want to visit again during the summer.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Are you thinking of rushing?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know... I hadn't really thought about it.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: You should do it! It's practically tradition!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I did it, $USR did it, and so did Chuck! My cousin's a few years older than I am, and he did exactly the same thing.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: It's gonna be great! Playin' football, slackin' off in class... We'll show you the ropes.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Hey, speaking of football... Do you want to play?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Come on! It'll be fun.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Yeah, I bet all the guys will be up for a little game.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. Sure. Let's go.
And so, Howard and the guys set up on the football field while $ZOE cheers from the sidelines.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Good catch, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard is such a good football player.
An hour later, the guys finish up the game.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: That was so fun! Just like old times, huh, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You guys were always the perfect duo back in high school. With the two of you on the field, we'll be unstoppable!

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: That's right!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Well, Flash, we better head back to M.A.N. We've got a meeting today and if we're not there, James will never let us hear the end of it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks for hanging out, guys.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Yeah, of course. Feel free to enjoy the campus.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: See you two later.
Bryce and $USR head off...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is something bothering you about...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm not?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean... I guess... You just... Don't... Usually make jokes.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Um, who is this girl, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's my girlfriend. $ZOE, is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No. Everything is fine. Have a muffin.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He always makes me laugh.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There you are! Girls, this is my awesome girlfriend, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Girlfriend? Aw... All the good ones are always taken!
Howard leans over and gives $ZOE a kiss!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You smell like muffins!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here, try one. I made your favorite, chocolate chip!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Aw, you two are really cute together.
$ZOE freezes!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: So, Howard, what are you doing later?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa, Viv! I have a girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: In fact, she's standing right there.

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Great. All the good ones always have girlfriends!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE you were gone for so long! How did the baking go?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You tell me. Have a muffin.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: So... Apparently muffins aren't my strong suit. How about I follow your lead?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sounds good to me.
Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Mmmm! These muffins smell great!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See? That was easy! Now, let's take these out to the rest of the people at the party.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I bet they're starving by now.
$ZOE and Beth head back into the den where they find Howard surrounded by girls!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And that's how we won the game!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: I had no idea you were such an athlete, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, it's no big deal.

nodes.speaker: Paula
nodes.text: It sounds like you were the star of the team. I'd say that's something to brag about.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, $ZOE. Be cool. Don't panic. They're not like, `all over` him...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, $ZOE. Be cool. Don't panic. They're not like, [color=#3b78e2][i]all over[/i][/color] him...

nodes.text: One of the girls laughs and grabs Howard's arm!

nodes.speaker: Viv
nodes.text: Hee hee! You're so funny, Howard!

options.label: That's what I love about him.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh... Yeah, sorry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: In particular, you may want to check on the muffins...

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Yeah, and clean up this entire mess! $ZOE is right, Beth. This kitchen is a wreck!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes. And. Um. About those muffins...
Beth runs around the kitchen starting to clean... Suddenly the smoke alarm goes off!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The oven!
$ZOE runs over and turns off the oven. She quickly throws open the window and starts fanning the smoke out!

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: This is a disaster! The muffins are ruined!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, baking muffins is easy! I'll help Beth make a new batch in no time.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: What? Oh no!
Beth opens the oven, and black smoke pours out!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: So much for not burning the muffins this time.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, it's no problem. Things burn all the time. You can always start over. Here, I'll do the muffins this time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And while I'm at it, I can help you get this whole kitchen set up. Keeping it a little cleaner will make baking a lot easier.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE. And good catch on the muffins. We could have had a real disaster on our hands.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No problem!
$ZOE leads Howard around campus...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where are they?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You'll see...
Howard sees a familiar face across the quad.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, there's $USR!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Over there! Don't you recognize him?

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Howard! Glad you could make it, man!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Hey, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $USR, Bryce! It's been too long. Thanks for letting us drop by.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: No problem. Flash and I were just hitting up O.M.G.'s Breakfast Bash.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Flash?

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Heh. That's me. Some of the guys call me Flash now.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You should see this guy on the field. He's gotten even better. We can play a pickup game.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Well, there's time for that later. You guys must be hungry.
$USR leads the group to a sorority house just off-campus... College girls are mingling about everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: This is the O.M.G. house. Beth and Paula are both around here somewhere...
$USR spots Beth and waves her over.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Hey, Howard! Welcome to O.M.G.'s Breakfast Bash!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Great, that's exactly what we need. More free-loaders. Beth, we're trying to throw a party here.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Sorry, Tina. I'll get back to work.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: And this time, try not to burn the muffins, okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, if you guys are baking, maybe I could help.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Really? That... Would be great, actually.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Yeah, that would be awesome! Are you sure you want to? We're supposed to be showing you around, not putting you to work.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, it's no trouble. I love baking!

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: That's exactly the kind of attitude we need.
Tina grabs $ZOE's hand and pulls her into the kitchen. Beth follows behind.

nodes.speaker: Tina
nodes.text: Here you go!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh wow.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This kitchen is a complete mess! Is that smoke coming out of the oven?

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've never seen a kitchen this messy! It's actually dangerous! But how should I say this? I don't want to insult them, but those muffins are about to ignite!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's... Just...
But just as fast, another feeling takes its place. A nagging feeling in the back of her head that says...
`Something's wrong.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Something's wrong.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... Do you want to come in and eat dinner with my family?
The next day, $ZOE is driving Howard to the park...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is this event we're going to again?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a little gathering I put together for you and some of your friends...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought you could use some cheering up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't really want to be cheered up right now, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know you don't. No one ever `wants` to be cheered up, but they're always cheerful once they are!
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you don't. No one ever [color=#3b78e2][i]wants[/i][/color] to be cheered up, but they're always cheerful once they are!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I can't argue with that logic...
Howard presses his head against the car window... A slow pop song comes on the radio...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But nice try, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I had to give it a shot... You know, you're less of a pushover than you used to be!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Publicly exposing Jessica's evil will do that to a girl...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I might have avoided confessing my awful feelings to Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But they're still my feelings...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `do` feel happy that Howard's going to Centerscore U. instead of Kingston!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] feel happy that Howard's going to Centerscore U. instead of Kingston!

nodes.text: Sam sits down on the bed next to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... Howard's really sad about all this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... He's pretty down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That surprises me... I always thought of him as a Centerscore U. kind of guy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I did too. I think maybe everyone did...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I'm sure you've already got some super sweet plan to cheer him up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know me so well! I planned a picnic with some friends...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hope it works...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure, Howard. You know I love spending time with your family!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... Are you sure everything's okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Of course! I'm going to Centerscore U, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right...
As night falls, $ZOE follows Howard into his house for dinner with his family...
Ten years later...
An older Howard and an older $ZOE emerge from the house...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, hurry it up! I'm going to be late for work at the Auto-Body Shop! I don't want Ryan to take it out of my paycheck!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know! I know, Sweetie! I'm just about ready. Did you grab your lunch? I packed you your favorite!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Awww... Did you bake me something?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, it's all store-bought. You know I don't have time for baking with all the shifts I'm working at the restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, have you seen my belt?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've told you a hundred times, your belt is around your waist!
Howard looks down at his waist and lifts up his bulky belly, revealing a belt underneath.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh...
He sighs and stares blankly down the street...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard? What are you looking at? Aren't you running late?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Did you ever think we'd end up like this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean, married?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean... working all the time... Never seeing each other.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I always thought we'd spend more time together, you know?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard, what's gotten into you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was just thinking... What if I had gotten into Kingston? What if Ryan hadn't been there to interrupt my interview?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do you think our lives would have been much different?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know where this is coming from, Howard... But, yes, of course our lives would have been different!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you mind telling me what's going on in that balding head of yours?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nothing. Just, you know, daydreaming...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, let's daydream our way to work.
Well... $ZOE and Howard are together in this ending, but it doesn't seem very happy, does it?
Play again and see if you can get a better ending, one where Howard doesn't have to lift his belly just to see his belt!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, would it be all right if I took a raincheck on dinner with your family?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure... Is something up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't worry. It's nothing for you to be concerned about or anything.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you scheming to try and cheer me up again?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Something like that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay. I'll tell my family you say 'hi'?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course!
Howard kisses $ZOE and walks into his house...
As soon as he's gone, $ZOE takes out her phone and calls up Angie!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Angie... I need a favor!
That night, $ZOE meets up with the representative from Kingston University.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for seeing me on such short notice.

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: Indeed. Angie spoke highly of you.
The professor takes a bite of a muffin.

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: I'll admit I was a bit concerned for my safety, meeting a strange student in a park at night...

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: But I can't imagine being mugged by someone who makes muffins as delicious as these!

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: Now tell me, dear, what is so important for you to meet me at such a late hour?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You have to give Howard another chance!

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: Howard? The boy who got into a fight before our interview even began?

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: I don't think so! Kingston Kings do not behave like street scoundrels!

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: If that's what this is about, then I'm afraid you've wasted both of our times!
Tears begin to well up in $ZOE's eyes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't understand...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard isn't who you think he is.

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: You seem to care very deeply for him...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I do! I'm... I'm asking you to give him another chance!

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: I don't think I can do that... Unless you can somehow prove to me that he isn't the scoundrel I know him to be!
$ZOE racks her brain, trying to come up with something on the spot!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: Exactly as I suspected!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait!
She shows him the pendant on the necklace hanging from her neck. It's a duck, facing to the left.

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: I... I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When I was really down once, Howard bought me this. Ducks are kind of our thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He has a matching duck pendant that faces the opposite direction. They're both magnetized, so that when the two of them are next to each other, they kiss!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He said that it's a reminder that whenever we're apart, I'm pulled to him... Just as he's pulled to me.

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: That's... Actually very sweet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And that's Howard. He's sweet and thoughtful and caring and kind... And just as I'm the kind of girl who brings muffins to a park...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard's the kind of guy who buys duck pendants to cheer me up... He's the kind of guy who doesn't get in fights, the kind of guy who belongs at a school like yours!

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: I see...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Will you give him another chance?

nodes.speaker: Interviewer
nodes.text: I'll have to sleep on it... Good night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... Good night.
He walks away, leaving $ZOE to wonder...
The next morning, $ZOE's phone buzzes, waking her up. She answers...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE? Did I wake you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't worry about it... You sound happy... What's up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You'll never guess! I got a call from the Kingston representative... He decided to give me a second chance!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! That's amazing! Did he say why?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, but who cares? It's happening today! Will you help me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Meet me at my house!
Howard hangs up. As $ZOE lets the moment sink in, her heart is filled with joy once again...
...Only this time, the feeling lasts.
You played a great game! You helped $ZOE cheer Howard up on his tour of Centerscore U.
And you also helped her realize that it wasn't the school for him... You helped her make the ultimate sacrifice!
The only question is... Can Howard prove that he's a Kingston King? Find out in the Season 12 Finale!

Speaking of which, there's a shabby chic party at O.M.G. tonight, and I want to wear a turquoise maxi dress...

nodes.text: Want to catch up? Grab the season sets starting with Set 1: Howard's Choice, available in Episodes on Demand!
The morning after the island party, $ZOE and Sam are talking...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe you missed the rest of Hector's party games... They were so bad that they were actually entertaining!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's worse than Spin the Coconut?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Bobbing for Pineapples.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ouch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, Erik said it was like making out with an underwater porcupine...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where'd you go anyway? I was talking to Amanda, then I turned around, and you were gone! I got worried...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry... I... I saw Nick kissing Sara... I couldn't bear it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.text: Wait! You didn't decide to post the message about their relationship to The Dirty Dish, did you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's just say sometimes `not` doing something is the best decision you can make...

nodes.text: Yay! I'm really proud of you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks! I couldn't have done it without you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But enough about my stuff. What about you, cuz? How are you doing with this whole Howard going to Centerscore U. thing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, um... Okay... I guess. I mean, he really wanted to go to Kingston.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, travel time to your boyfriend just dropped from twenty hours to twenty minutes...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Some part of you has got to feel happy about that!
